from rest_framework.generics import ListAPIView
from rest_framework.permissions import IsAuthenticated
from mailer.models import MessageLog
from .serializers import MessageLogSerializer

class DeliveryAuditLogListView(ListAPIView):
    permission_classes = [IsAuthenticated]
    serializer_class = MessageLogSerializer

    def get_queryset(self):
        queryset = MessageLog.objects.all()
        target_recipient = self.request.query_params.get('recipient')
        if target_recipient:
            # Filters MessageLog by arbitrary user-supplied recipient address
            queryset = queryset.filter(to_address=target_recipient)
        return queryset
diagnosis: DeliveryAuditLogListView permits any authenticated caller to query django-mailer MessageLog entries by specifying an arbitrary recipient email address. Because the endpoint does not restrict the search to the caller's own email address or verify tenant boundaries, any standard user can inspect delivery timestamps, subject lines, and transmission statuses for other users.
